tools.name: openwater_list_programs
tools.description: List the programs (awards, grants, scholarships or events) of this organization, with their rounds and categories. Good first call to find a programId. OpenWater API: GET /v2/Programs.

tools.name: openwater_get_program
tools.description: Get one program by id, with its rounds and application categories. OpenWater API: GET /v2/Programs/{id}.

tools.name: openwater_list_applications
tools.description: List applications (submissions), optionally for one program. Filter by time to find recent or finalized ones. OpenWater API: GET /v2/Applications.

tools.name: openwater_get_application
tools.description: Get one application by id: its program, applicant, category, collaborators and per-round submission status. OpenWater API: GET /v2/Applications/{id}.

tools.name: openwater_list_users
tools.description: List users (applicants, judges, session chairs and staff) with optional filters. Passwords are never returned. OpenWater API: GET /v2/Users.

tools.name: openwater_get_user
tools.description: Get one user by id, with role flags and profile field values. OpenWater API: GET /v2/Users/{id}.

tools.name: openwater_create_user
tools.description: Create a user (for example an applicant). Adds a new record. Sends no e-mail unless suppress_emails is false. OpenWater API: POST /v2/Users.

tools.name: openwater_update_user
tools.description: Change the name, e-mail or your own third-party id of one user. Only the fields you pass are sent. Passwords cannot be set here. OpenWater API: PATCH /v2/Users/{id}.

tools.name: openwater_list_evaluations
tools.description: List judge evaluations (scores and notes) for a program, round, application or judge. OpenWater API: GET /v2/Evaluations.

tools.name: openwater_list_sessions
tools.description: List the sessions (event slots or panels) of a program, optionally for one session chair. OpenWater API: GET /v2/Sessions.

tools.name: openwater_list_funds
tools.description: List the funds (grant or award budgets) of this organization. OpenWater API: GET /v2/Funds.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "openwater_list_applications" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: programId, userId, code, startedAtUtc, startedBeforeUtc, finalizedAtUtc, lastModifiedSinceUtc, pageIndex, pageSize

findings.detail: Description of "openwater_list_users" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
